run_dumpVrLog: run the pybullet VR log parser script to dump and parse a binary VR log file
readLogFile_parse_binary_log: readLogFile parses a binary VR log file by reading its header keys and struct format then unpacking records
readLogFile_unpack_struct_records: readLogFile splits binary data by alignment bytes and unpacks each chunk into a list of struct records
unpack_vr_button_events: unpack packed VR controller button events from binary log records to identify down triggered and released buttons
review_readLogFile: review the readLogFile function that reads binary VR log files and returns parsed struct records
